questions.learningObjective: Define and distinguish key film studies concepts
questions.stem: Which statement best defines Protagonist?

options.text: It is the central character around whom the main action of the story revolves.
It is the character or force that opposes the protagonist's goals.
It is the transformation a character undergoes over the course of the story.
It is a complex, multi-dimensional figure possessing conflicting traits.

questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Protagonist.
